prose: Odin's favorite wizard, Benjamin Balderson, returns to InnerVerse to give us the 101 course on the process of laboratory alchemy. In this episode you'll learn the steps of alchemy from distillation to chemical wedding, the logic of alcohol-free tinctures, the alchemical fractal in nature, and how this study may impact the course of our after-life journey.
ext: We dive deep into how nature alchemizes on all scales, performing the great work on ourselves, the meaning behind quickening synchronicity, how alchemy relates to astrotheology, alchenomics of currency, ancestors, and the two I AMs.
music: Outro, "The Weight of Words (Hedflux Remix)" by Kaya Project
InnerVerse intro theme by Conspiracy Music Guru
